1.def: 'To be' — «bo'lmoq» fe'li. U ingliz tilida har bir gapda egadan keyin kerak bo'ladi: ism, yosh, kasb, joy, holatni aytganda. O'zbekchada «Men talabaman» desak, inglizchada «Men BO'LAMAN talaba» deymiz.
forms: I am / He, She, It is / We, You, They are
I am a student. She is happy. They are at home.
He is not (isn't) tired. We are not (aren't) late.
Are you ready? Is she a doctor?
rules: I → am, he/she/it → is, we/you/they → are.
Qisqartma: I'm, he's, she's, we're, they're, isn't, aren't.
Savolda fe'l gapning boshiga chiqadi, so'z tartibi o'zgaradi.
Ism va kasbdan oldin a / an qo'yiladi: I am a teacher.
ex: I am Aziz. I am 20 years old.
Is your mother at work? — No, she is at home.
We are not hungry, but we are tired.

2.def: Present Simple — odat, doimiy ish va umumiy haqiqatni bildiradi: har kuni, tez-tez, odatda nima qilasiz. Fe'lning oddiy shakli ishlatiladi, faqat he / she / it dan keyin -s qo'shiladi.
forms: I / you / we / they + fe'l; he / she / it + fe'l + s
She watches TV. He goes home.
rules: Belgi so'zlar: every day, always, usually, often, sometimes, never, on Mondays.
Chastota so'zlari (always, usually, never) asosiy fe'ldan oldin turadi.
have → has (he has), go → goes, do → does.
ex: I get up at 7 o'clock every day.
Men har kuni soat 7 da turaman.
My brother works in a bank.
The sun rises in the east.

3.def: Present Simple'da savol va inkor 'do / does' yordamchi fe'li bilan tuziladi. Yordamchi fe'l zamon va shaxsni ko'tarib turadi, shuning uchun asosiy fe'l o'z shaklida qoladi (-s yo'q).
forms: I / you / we / they + don't + fe'l; he / she / it + doesn't + fe'l
I don't like tea. She doesn't live here.
Do you speak English? Does he work here?
Where do you live? What does she do?
rules: does / doesn't dan keyin fe'lga -s QO'SHILMAYDI: Does he work? (works emas).
Qisqa javob: Yes, I do. / No, she doesn't.
ex: Do you drink coffee in the morning? — Yes, I do.
err: does dan keyin fe'l oddiy shaklda.

4.def: Present Continuous — aynan hozir, gap gapirilayotgan paytda davom etayotgan ish. Shuningdek, hozirgi kunlarda vaqtinchalik davom etayotgan ishlar uchun ham ishlatiladi.
forms: I am reading. She is cooking.
rules: Belgi so'zlar: now, at the moment, right now, today, Look!, Listen!
-e tushadi: make → making. Qisqa fe'l undoshi ikkilanadi: run → running, sit → sitting.
Holat fe'llari (know, like, want, love) odatda -ing shaklida ishlatilmaydi.
ex: Be quiet! The baby is sleeping.
What are you doing? — I'm cooking dinner.

5.def: Present Simple — odat va doimiy narsa (har kuni). Present Continuous — hozir yoki vaqtinchalik davom etayotgan ish. Farq: «odatda nima qilasan» va «hozir nima qilyapsan».
rules: Simple belgilari: always, usually, every day, on Sundays, never.
Continuous belgilari: now, at the moment, today, these days, Look!
Holat fe'llari (like, love, want, need, know, understand) faqat Simple'da: I want water.
ex: He usually walks to work, but today he is taking a taxi.
U odatda ishga piyoda boradi, lekin bugun taksida ketyapti.
err: I am going to school every day.
I go to school every day.

6.def: 'have' va 'have got' — «bor» ma'nosida egalik, oila, kasallik, tashqi ko'rinishni aytishda ishlatiladi. Ikkalasi ham bir xil ma'noda, 'have got' ko'proq og'zaki nutqda.
forms: I / you / we / they have; he / she / it has
I have got a brother. He has got a cat.
haven't / hasn't got; Have / Has + subject + got?
I haven't got a pen. Have you got a phone?
rules: 'have' bilan inkor: don't have / doesn't have (I don't have time).
he / she / it uchun: has.
Ovqat va harakatda 'have' ishlatiladi (got emas): have breakfast, have a shower.
ex: Has she got a dog? — No, she hasn't.
We don't have a lot of time.

7.def: was / were — 'to be' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli: «edi, bo'ldi». Kecha, o'tgan yili, oldin qayerda edingiz, qanday edi — shularni aytishda ishlatiladi.
forms: I / he / she / it + was; we / you / they + were
I was at home. They were happy.
Were you tired? Was it cold?
rules: Belgi so'zlar: yesterday, last week, ago, in 2010, then.
there was / there were — «bor edi»: There were many people.
ex: Where were you last night? — I was at work.
Kecha kechqurun qayerda eding? — Ishda edim.

8.def: Past Simple — o'tgan zamonda tugagan, aniq vaqtga bog'liq ish. To'g'ri fe'llarga -ed qo'shiladi: work → worked.
forms: I worked. She played. They watched.
-e bilan tugasa + d; undosh + y → ied; qisqa fe'l undoshi ikkilanadi
like → liked, study → studied, stop → stopped
rules: Belgi so'zlar: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020.
-ed uch xil o'qiladi: /t/ (worked), /d/ (played), /id/ (wanted, needed).
ex: We watched a film last night.
He studied hard and passed the exam.
U qattiq o'qidi va imtihondan o'tdi.

9.def: Noto'g'ri fe'llarning o'tgan zamon shakli -ed bilan hosil bo'lmaydi: ularni yodlash kerak. Eng ko'p ishlatiladigan fe'llar shular.
forms: go → went, see → saw, eat → ate, buy → bought, make → made
I went to the market and bought bread.
have → had, take → took, come → came, give → gave, write → wrote, get → got
She wrote a letter. We came late.
rules: Shakl barcha shaxslar uchun bir xil: I went, he went, they went.
Ro'yxat 'Past Simple' ustuni — fe'lning 2-shakli.
ex: Yesterday I saw an old friend.
She took the bus and came home.

10.def: Past Simple'da savol va inkor 'did / didn't' bilan tuziladi. did o'tgan zamonni o'zi ko'taradi, shuning uchun asosiy fe'l oddiy shaklga qaytadi.
forms: I didn't go out. She didn't call.
Did you see him? Did they win?
Where did you go? What did he say?
rules: did / didn't dan keyin fe'l o'tgan shaklga EMAS, oddiy shaklga tushadi.
Qisqa javob: Yes, I did. / No, we didn't.
was / were bilan did ishlatilmaydi: Were you tired? (Did you were emas).
ex: Did you do your homework? — Yes, I did.
I didn't sleep well last night.

11.def: be going to — oldindan rejalashtirilgan niyat yoki hozirgi belgilarga ko'ra ishonchli bashorat. «... qilmoqchiman / qilaman» ma'nosiga yaqin.
forms: am / is / are + going to + fe'l
I am going to study tonight.
am / is / are + not + going to + fe'l
Am / Is / Are + subject + going to + fe'l?
rules: Belgi so'zlar: tomorrow, next week, tonight, soon, in the future.
Belgiga qarab bashorat: Look at the clouds! It is going to rain.
ex: I'm going to visit my uncle next week.
She is going to be a doctor.
Are you going to buy this phone?
err: I am going to eat now.

12.def: can — qila olish, imkoniyat, ruxsat so'rash. could — o'tgan zamondagi qobiliyat va muloyim iltimos. Modal fe'llar bo'lgani uchun -s olmaydi va fe'lning oddiy shakli bilan keladi.
forms: I can swim. She can speak French.
He can't drive. I couldn't sleep.
Can you help me? Could you open the window?
rules: he / she / it bilan ham 'can' (cans emas).
can dan keyin 'to' kelmaydi.
Could you ...? — Can you ...? ga qaraganda muloyimroq.
ex: I can play the piano, but I can't sing.
Pianino chala olaman, lekin kuylay olmayman.
When I was five, I could read.

13.def: would like — «xohlayman» ning muloyim shakli: kafe, do'kon, taklif va iltimoslarda ishlatiladi. 'want' dan ko'ra odobliroq eshitiladi.
forms: I'd like a coffee. I'd like to book a table.
Would you like + ot / to + fe'l?
I wouldn't like to be late.
rules: I would = I'd.
Taklifga javob: Yes, please. / No, thank you.
Do you like...? — umumiy yoqtirish; Would you like...? — hozirgi taklif.
ex: I'd like a table for two, please.
Would you like to come to my party?
What would you like to drink?

14.def: Inglizcha savolda so'z tartibi aniq: yordamchi fe'l egadan oldin keladi. O'zbekchada tartib o'zgarmaydi, inglizchada o'zgaradi — shuning uchun tartibni yodlash kerak.
forms: Do you like pizza? Can she swim?
Where do you live? When did he come?
who, what, where, when, why, how, which
How old are you? Why are you late?
rules: Yordamchi fe'llar: do / does / did, am / is / are, can, will.
Faqat be fe'lida: Where is he? (do kerak emas).
ex: What time does the film start?

15.def: Who va What savollari ikki xil: ega haqida so'rasak (kim ... qildi?) yordamchi fe'l ishlatilmaydi; to'ldiruvchi haqida so'rasak (kimni / nimani?) yordamchi fe'l kerak.
forms: Who / What + do / does / did + ega + fe'l?
Who did you call? What do you want?
rules: Ega savolida do / does / did QO'YILMAYDI.
Who + he/she/it kabi uchinchi shaxs bilan: Who lives here? (lives).
ex: Who broke the window? — Tom did.

16.def: Qisqa javob — savolga to'liq gap aytmasdan, yordamchi fe'lni takrorlab javob berish. Ingliz tilida «ha / yo'q» o'rniga yordamchi fe'l ishlatiladi: Yes, I do.
forms: Do you like tea? — Yes, I do.
Is she tired? — No, she isn't.
rules: Javobdagi yordamchi fe'l savoldagi bilan bir xil bo'ladi: Did you...? → I did; Can you...? → I can; Are you...? → I am.
Faqat «Yes» yoki «No» deyish qo'pol eshitiladi.
ex: Are you a student? — Yes, I am.
Does he speak English? — No, he doesn't.
Can you drive? — Yes, I can.
err: Do you like it? — Yes, I like.
Are you tired? — No, I don't.

17.def: Sanaladigan otlarni bittalab sanash mumkin (an apple, two apples). Sanalmaydigan otlarni sanab bo'lmaydi (water, rice, money) va ular ko'plik shakli olmaydi.
forms: a / an + birlik; ko'plik: ot + s
water, rice, milk, money, bread, information, advice
a glass of water, a piece of bread, a bottle of milk
I need a cup of tea.
rules: Ko'plik: -s (cat → cats), -es (box → boxes), -ies (baby → babies), noto'g'ri: man → men, child → children, foot → feet.
Sanalmaydigan otdan keyin fe'l birlikda: The water is cold.
ex: I have two brothers and some money.
Mening ikkita akam va ozgina pulim bor.
Can I have a glass of water?

18.def: a / an — noaniq birlik ot oldidan «bitta, biror» ma'nosida: birinchi marta eslatayotganda yoki kasbni aytganda. a — undosh TOVUSH oldidan, an — unli TOVUSH oldidan.
forms: a book, a university (yu-), a house
an apple, an hour (soat — h o'qilmaydi), an umbrella
rules: Faqat birlikdagi sanaladigan otlar bilan: a car, lekin cars.
Kasb: She is a nurse.
Yozuvga emas, TALAFFUZGA qaraladi.
ex: I have a dog and an umbrella.

19.def: the — aniq ot oldidan: gapiruvchi ham, tinglovchi ham qaysi narsa haqida gap ketayotganini biladi. Bir marta tilga olingan narsa, yagona narsa (the sun) yoki aniq tasvirlangan narsa oldida ishlatiladi.
forms: I saw a dog. The dog was big.
the sun, the moon, the world, the internet
rules: Umumiy gapda artikl yo'q: I like music. (the music emas).
Ishlatilmaydi: ovqat nomlari (have breakfast), tillar (speak English), ko'pchilik shahar va mamlakatlar.
the + superlativ: the best, the biggest.
ex: I bought a shirt. The shirt is blue.

20.def: some va any — noaniq miqdorni bildiradi («ozgina, biroz»). some — darak gapda va taklif / iltimosda; any — inkor va savolda.
forms: I have some friends. There is some milk.
Would you like some tea? Can I have some water?
rules: no = not any: I have no time = I don't have any time.
something / anything / someone / anyone ham shu qoidaga amal qiladi.
ex: There are some apples in the bag.
Is there any bread at home?

21.def: many — sanaladigan ko'plik otlar bilan, much — sanalmaydigan otlar bilan (asosan savol va inkorda). a lot of / lots of — ikkalasi bilan, darak gapda.
forms: How many books? Not many people.
How much water? I haven't got much time.
a lot of + har qanday ot
She has a lot of friends and a lot of money.
rules: Savolda: How many ...? / How much ...?
Darak gapda 'much' kam ishlatiladi, 'a lot of' tabiiyroq.
a few (sanaladigan) / a little (sanalmaydigan) — «ozgina».
ex: We have a lot of homework.
err: I have a lot of friends.

22.def: there is / there are — «bor» ma'nosida biror narsaning joyda borligini aytadi. Birlik bo'lsa there is, ko'plik bo'lsa there are.
forms: There is + birlik / sanalmaydigan; There are + ko'plik
There is a park near my house. There are two chairs.
Is there a bank near here? Are there any cafes?
rules: Fe'l keyingi otga moslashadi: There is a book and two pens. (birinchi otga qarab)
Qisqa javob: Yes, there is. / No, there aren't.
Egalikda: I have a car (biror kishida bor); borlik: There is a car (joyda bor).
ex: There is a bus stop next to the school.
Are there any eggs in the fridge?
err: There are a book on the table.
There is a book on the table.
It is a bank near here.
There is a bank near here.

23.def: Egalik olmoshlarining ikki turi bor: ot oldida keladigan sifat (my, your, his, her, our, their) va otsiz alohida keladigan olmosh (mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs).
forms: my / your / his / her / its / our / their + ot
This is my book. Her name is Anna.
mine / yours / his / hers / ours / theirs
This book is mine. Is that yours?
rules: his va her egasining jinsiga qarab: his brother (erkak), her brother (ayol).
's — ot egaligi: Tom's car, my sister's phone.
its (egalik) va it's (it is) ni adashtirmang.
ex: My phone is new, but yours is old.
Mening telefonim yangi, seniki esa eski.
This is their house. It is theirs.
Whose bag is this? — It's mine.

24.def: Vaqt predloglari: at — aniq vaqt nuqtasi, on — kun va sana, in — uzoqroq muddat (oy, yil, fasl, kunning qismi).
forms: at 5 o'clock, at night, at noon
on Monday, on 5 May, on my birthday
in + oy, yil, fasl, kun qismi
in June, in 2024, in summer, in the morning
rules: Istisno: at night, lekin in the morning / afternoon / evening.
this, next, last, every oldidan predlog qo'yilmaydi: next week, last year, every day.
from ... to / until — boshlanish va tugash.
ex: The lesson starts at 9 a.m. on Monday.
Dars dushanba kuni soat 9 da boshlanadi.
We go to the village in summer.

25.def: Joy predloglari: at — nuqta, manzil (maktabda, bekatda); on — sirt ustida; in — biror joy ichida (xona, shahar, mamlakat).
forms: at home, at school, at work, at the bus stop
on the table, on the wall, on the second floor
in the room, in Tashkent, in Uzbekistan, in bed
rules: Harakat predloglari: to (tomon), from (dan).
Boshqa foydali predloglar: next to (yonida), behind (orqasida), between (orasida), under (ostida), in front of (oldida).
ex: My keys are on the table.
She lives in Samarkand, in a small flat.
I'm at the station. Where are you?
err: The book is in the table.
The book is on the table.
